summary: Ran comprehensive pytest suite (33 tests) against Ghostel backend covering auth, admin dashboard, users CRUD, groups CRUD, reports moderation, notifications, settings, and CSV exports. All 33 tests PASSED. Auth (Bearer header + ?token= for CSV), RBAC (401 without token, 403 for non-admin), data persistence (PATCH then GET verification), and validation (invalid action, cannot delete self, duplicate email) all behave as specified.

minor.issue: messages_chart uses synthetic fallback `(50 + d*7) % 200` when no messages exist - acceptable for mock data MVP but should be documented or seeded explicitly.
Cookies are set with secure=False; since site is served over HTTPS this works but cookies are not strictly Secure. Bearer header is the primary mechanism per agent context, so non-blocking.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting implemented (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Out of scope for MVP mock-data spec but worth noting.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~500 lines) is acceptable size but could be split into routers (auth, admin_users, admin_groups, admin_moderation, admin_settings, export) for maintainability as features grow.
Bcrypt hash format verified ($2b$ via bcrypt.gensalt()). JWT_SECRET sourced from env. ObjectId properly excluded everywhere via {"_id":0} projections.
Seed admin updates existing admin password if .env password changed - idempotent and correct.

Dashboard messages_chart fallback (`msgs or (50 + d * 7) % 200`) can produce non-zero values when actual count is 0 - this is intentional mock behaviour but mixes real + synthetic data, may confuse later developers.
No pagination on /api/admin/users or /api/admin/groups (hardcoded .to_list(500/2000)). Fine for MVP, but add limit/offset before scaling.

seed_data_creation: Tests create transient TEST_ prefixed users/groups via register + admin POST and clean them up via DELETE in same test. Notifications/settings updates persist (acceptable for mock data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. All admin endpoints accept Bearer Authorization header; CSV exports also accept ?token= query param. Cookies are set but not required. Use ADMIN credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_ghostel_api.py can be reused as regression suite.
